[F003] Implementation complete. Probe runs in 25ms on the live 298-file tree (vs the 2s budget), and the live state is `stale_minor` exactly as expected for an in-flight working tree.

## Summary

Added the `architecture_drift` probe to `scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py`. The probe reuses F001's `Crawler.fingerprint()` to compute a current source-tree hash, diffs it against the per-file map stored in `docs/architecture/architecture.json`, and classifies the result as `fresh` / `stale_minor` (<5% files changed) / `stale_major` (≥5%) / `absent`. Default mode emits WARN for stale/absent; the new `--architecture-drift-strict` flag promotes `stale_major` and `absent` to FAIL (exit 2 under the strict-codes matrix), while `stale_minor` stays advisory in both modes. The probe attaches a structured `details` payload (state + truncated changed_files list + unchanged count + recommendation) so the existing `--json` output carries the F003 contract. Wired the new flag through both `scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py` and the `dontpanic_orchestrate.cli._doctor_main` wrapper, mirroring the existing `--validate-plans-strict` plumbing so advisory-mode WARNs don't escalate canonical exit codes.

Added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_architecture_drift_f003.py` with 11 fixture cases covering all five acceptance shapes (fresh, stale_minor, stale_major, absent, --strict blocker for both stale_major + absent), JSON shape validation, the stale_minor-stays-advisory invariant, the changed_files trunca
